violations.text: No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. Additional staff to be certified discussed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2026

Staff were observed not wearing effective hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The following were observed in poor repair: -the antimicrobial produce wash dispenser was observed held together with tape -the walk-in freezer gasket -cold drawers (out of service prior to inspection) New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2026
The door to the staff toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/15/2026
